relevance: 動作障礙領域最大國際年會下一屆已公告日期與城市（官方場館名稱尚未公布）。本站週檢時僅查得日期與城市，尚無任何議程或MSA相關發表資訊，不臆測內容；待官方議程公告後再補充。

This week's check found only the date and city, with no agenda or MSA-related presentations announced yet; no content is inferred, and this entry will be updated once the official program is published.

name: MDS International Congress（國際動作障礙學會年會）
relevance: 動作障礙領域最大國際年會；MSA 臨床與在研療法發表重鎮（Alterity ATH434 曾於 2025 年會發表）。Lundbeck 已公告將於 10/5 發表 amlenetug 樞紐 Ph3 MASCOT 試驗（NCT06706622，n=401）收案多樣性基線資料（Late-breaking oral）、mUMSARS Part I 量表心理計量驗證（含中文版）、腦脊髓液生物標記與一項區分 MSA／帕金森氏症的 C 端 α-突觸核蛋白檢測報告。

en.name: MDS International Congress
en.relevance: The largest international meeting in movement disorders and a key venue for MSA clinical and pipeline presentations (Alterity presented ATH434 data at the 2025 congress). Lundbeck has announced it will present, on 10/5, baseline diversity data from the pivotal Phase III MASCOT trial of amlenetug (NCT06706622, n=401) as a late-breaking oral, psychometric validation of the modified UMSARS Part I scale (including a Chinese-language version), cerebrospinal fluid biomarker work, and a report on a C-terminal alpha-synuclein assay to differentiate MSA from Parkinson's disease.

name: International MSA Congress（Mission MSA）
location: 美國德州達拉斯（The Westin Galleria Dallas，另提供線上參與）
relevance: MSA 專屬國際科學暨臨床大會，集結研究者、臨床醫師、產業與病友。下屆已公布地點與日期，由 Mission MSA 與 UT Southwestern MSA 卓越中心合辦。

en.name: International MSA Congress (Mission MSA)
